title.rendered: 15 Best Places to Visit from Abu Dhabi for Your International Holiday

content.rendered:
Abu Dhabi is one of the world’s best starting points for international travel. With its major airport, extensive airline network, and convenient connections to Asia, Europe, Africa, and the Middle East, travelers can reach a wide range of holiday destinations without spending too much time in transit.

Whether you are planning a three-day weekend break, a family vacation, a romantic escape, or a longer international holiday, there are plenty of destinations worth considering.

The best places to visit from Abu Dhabi depend on your budget, travel dates, visa requirements, preferred activities, and how much time you have available. Nearby destinations such as Oman and Azerbaijan are suitable for shorter trips, while Turkey, Thailand, Egypt, and Japan offer a more comprehensive international vacation experience.

If you are looking for the best countries to visit from Abu Dhabi, here are 15 destinations that deserve a place on your travel list.

What Are the Best Places to Visit from Abu Dhabi?

For travelers who want a quick recommendation, some of the best international destinations from Abu Dhabi include Oman, Azerbaijan, Georgia, Armenia, Saudi Arabia, Jordan, Egypt, Turkey, Kazakhstan, Maldives, Sri Lanka, Thailand, Malaysia, Seychelles, and Japan.

The right choice depends on your travel style:

Flight schedules, airfare, visa rules, and entry requirements can change, so always verify the latest requirements before booking.

1. Oman: One of the Best Short Trips from Abu Dhabi

Oman is among the easiest destinations to consider when you want a quick international escape from Abu Dhabi. Muscat offers a combination of beaches, mountains, traditional markets, historic forts, and Arabian hospitality.

The destination works particularly well for families, couples, and travelers who do not want to spend several days in transit.

Popular places include Muscat, Nizwa, Wadi Shab, Jebel Akhdar, and Salalah. If you have only a few days available, Muscat can be combined with nearby attractions for a relaxing break.

Best for: Families, couples, nature lovers, road trips

Ideal duration: 2 to 4 days

2. Azerbaijan: A Popular International Destination from Abu Dhabi

Azerbaijan is a strong option for travelers searching for places to visit near Abu Dhabi internationally. Baku combines modern architecture, Caspian Sea views, historic neighborhoods, restaurants, and shopping.

You can also add destinations such as Gabala or Shahdag to your itinerary for mountain scenery and outdoor activities.

The relatively short journey makes Azerbaijan particularly attractive for a long weekend or short holiday.

Best for: Couples, families, first time international travelers

Ideal duration: 3 to 5 days

3. Georgia: Mountains, Culture and Local Food

Georgia remains a popular choice for travelers from the UAE who want a destination with mountains, historic architecture, food, and outdoor experiences.

Tbilisi is a good starting point, with its old town, sulfur baths, viewpoints, restaurants, and cultural attractions. Travelers with more time can continue toward Kazbegi, Gudauri, or other mountain regions.

Georgia is particularly suitable for travelers looking for weekend getaways from Abu Dhabi or a slightly longer break.

Best for: Couples, adventure travelers, food lovers

Ideal duration: 4 to 7 days

4. Armenia: A Scenic Escape for a Short Holiday

Armenia offers a different experience with historic monasteries, mountain landscapes, local cuisine, and a relaxed atmosphere.

Yerevan is the natural starting point, while day trips can take you to Lake Sevan, Garni Temple, Geghard Monastery, and scenic mountain areas.

Entry requirements can vary depending on nationality and UAE residency status, so travelers should check the latest official requirements before making arrangements.

Best for: History lovers, couples, nature enthusiasts

Ideal duration: 3 to 5 days

5. Saudi Arabia: Modern Cities and Cultural Experiences

Saudi Arabia has become an increasingly interesting option for international travel from the UAE. Riyadh offers modern attractions, restaurants, shopping, and cultural experiences, while Jeddah combines Red Sea views with historic architecture.

For travelers interested in heritage and dramatic landscapes, AlUla is another major attraction.

Saudi Arabia can work well for a short city break or a longer itinerary combining multiple destinations.

Best for: Culture, food, city breaks, adventure

Ideal duration: 3 to 6 days

6. Jordan: History, Petra and Desert Adventures

Jordan is an excellent choice for travelers interested in history and natural landscapes.

Petra is the country’s most famous attraction, but the experience does not end there. Visitors can also consider Wadi Rum, the Dead Sea, Amman, and historical sites around the country.

A well planned itinerary can cover several major attractions within a few days, making Jordan one of the practical short trips from Abu Dhabi.

Best for: History, adventure, couples and families

Ideal duration: 3 to 5 days

7. Egypt: A Classic Holiday Destination from Abu Dhabi

Egypt is one of the most recognizable international holiday destinations for travelers interested in ancient history.

Cairo provides access to the Giza pyramid complex, the Egyptian Museum and other historic attractions. Travelers with additional time can combine Cairo with Alexandria, Luxor, Aswan, or Red Sea destinations.

Waytransit Travels & Tourism currently offers Egypt holiday packages that include options for travelers departing from Abu Dhabi.

Best for: Families, history lovers, first time international travelers

Ideal duration: 4 to 7 days

8. Turkey: A Complete International Holiday Experience

Turkey is one of the best holiday destinations from Abu Dhabi if you want a combination of history, food, shopping, culture, and scenic landscapes.

Istanbul is an obvious starting point, with attractions such as Hagia Sophia, the Blue Mosque, the Grand Bazaar, and the Bosphorus. Travelers with more time can add Cappadocia, Antalya, Pamukkale, or Ephesus.

Waytransit Travels & Tourism offers Turkey holiday packages from Abu Dhabi that can include flights, accommodation, transfers, breakfast, and travel insurance, depending on the selected package.

Best for: Couples, families, culture, food and sightseeing

Ideal duration: 5 to 8 days

Suggested image alt text: Popular international holiday destinations from Abu Dhabi including Istanbul, Baku, Tbilisi and Cairo.

9. Kazakhstan: Mountains and City Experiences

Almaty is an excellent option for travelers who want a combination of city attractions and nature.

The city is surrounded by mountains and offers access to scenic locations such as Big Almaty Lake and mountain resorts. It can be an attractive choice for travelers who want something different from a conventional beach vacation.

For UAE residents looking for an affordable international trip from Abu Dhabi, Kazakhstan can be worth comparing with other Central Asian destinations.

Best for: Adventure, nature, couples and photographers

Ideal duration: 4 to 6 days

10. Maldives: A Perfect Beach Escape

If your idea of an international holiday involves turquoise water, beaches, resorts, and relaxation, the Maldives is hard to overlook.

The Maldives is especially popular among couples celebrating honeymoons, anniversaries, and special occasions. It also works for travelers who simply want to disconnect from a busy schedule.

Although it can be positioned as a luxury destination, travelers can find different accommodation categories depending on their budget.

Best for: Honeymoons, couples, luxury holidays

Ideal duration: 3 to 6 days

11. Sri Lanka: Beaches, Wildlife and Culture

Sri Lanka is one of the more diverse destinations for travelers from Abu Dhabi. A single trip can include beaches, tea plantations, wildlife, ancient cities, mountains, and local cultural experiences.

Colombo can serve as an entry point, while destinations such as Kandy, Ella, Galle, and the southern coast offer very different experiences.

Sri Lanka is a good option if you want more activities than a traditional beach holiday.

Best for: Families, nature lovers, couples and adventure travelers

Ideal duration: 5 to 8 days

12. Thailand: Beaches, Food and Entertainment

Thailand remains a strong choice for travelers looking for a longer international holiday from Abu Dhabi.

Bangkok is ideal for shopping, food, temples, and city experiences, while Phuket and Krabi are popular for beaches and island activities. Chiang Mai offers a different atmosphere with temples, markets, and mountain scenery.

Thailand is particularly suitable for travelers who want a combination of sightseeing and relaxation.

Best for: Families, couples, groups and beach lovers

Ideal duration: 5 to 8 days

13. Malaysia: A Family Friendly International Getaway

Malaysia offers a combination of modern cities, cultural attractions, food, shopping, nature, and family entertainment.

Kuala Lumpur is the country’s most popular starting point, with attractions such as the Petronas Twin Towers, shopping districts, restaurants, and family friendly attractions.

Travelers with more time can add Langkawi, Penang, or other destinations depending on their interests.

Best for: Families, shopping, food and city breaks

Ideal duration: 5 to 7 days

14. Seychelles: Tropical Beaches and Relaxation

Seychelles is an excellent choice for travelers who prefer beaches, nature, and a slower pace.

The islands are known for their scenic coastline, clear water, tropical vegetation, and distinctive granite landscapes. It is particularly popular for romantic holidays but can also work for families and travelers looking for a peaceful escape.

For travelers searching for affordable international trips from Abu Dhabi, Seychelles may not always be the cheapest option, but comparing flight and hotel packages can help manage the overall cost.

Best for: Couples, honeymooners, nature lovers

Ideal duration: 4 to 7 days

15. Japan: The Choice for a Longer International Holiday

Japan is further away than many of the destinations on this list, but it is an excellent option when you have enough time for a longer vacation.

Tokyo offers technology, shopping, entertainment, food, and modern city life. Kyoto provides historic temples, traditional neighborhoods, and cultural experiences, while destinations around Mount Fuji offer spectacular scenery.

Japan works best when you can dedicate at least a week to the trip instead of trying to fit everything into a short break.

Waytransit Travels & Tourism currently lists Japan tour packages from Abu Dhabi, including package options with travel insurance.

Best for: Culture, food, families, couples and first time Japan visitors

Ideal duration: 7 to 12 days

How to Choose the Best Country to Visit from Abu Dhabi

Choosing between international destinations from Abu Dhabi becomes easier when you consider five factors.

1. Your Available Time

For two to four days, consider Oman, Azerbaijan, Armenia, Jordan, or Saudi Arabia.

For five to seven days, Turkey, Egypt, Georgia, Thailand, Malaysia, Sri Lanka, and Kazakhstan offer more itinerary possibilities.

For seven days or longer, destinations such as Japan can provide a more rewarding experience.

2. Your Travel Budget

The total cost of an international trip is not determined by airfare alone. Consider accommodation, airport transfers, meals, activities, travel insurance, visa costs, and local transportation.

Comparing complete packages can sometimes make budgeting easier than booking every component separately.

3. Visa Requirements

Visa requirements depend on your passport, UAE residency status, destination, travel dates, and other factors. Do not assume that having a UAE residence visa automatically provides visa free entry to every country.

Waytransit Travels & Tourism provides international visa assistance for multiple destinations and can help travelers understand documentation and application requirements.

4. Travel Season

Weather can dramatically affect the quality and cost of your holiday. Before booking, check the destination’s seasonal conditions, public holidays, peak tourism periods, and possible weather disruptions.

5. Your Holiday Style

Ask yourself what you actually want from the trip.

For beaches, consider Maldives, Seychelles, Sri Lanka, or Thailand.

For history, consider Egypt, Jordan, Turkey, or Japan.

For mountains and nature, consider Georgia, Armenia, Kazakhstan, or Oman.

For city breaks, consider Baku, Istanbul, Riyadh, Kuala Lumpur, or Tokyo.

How to Find Cheap Air Tickets from Abu Dhabi

Airfare can be one of the biggest parts of an international travel budget. If you are looking for cheap air tickets from Abu Dhabi, compare different travel dates and airlines before confirming your booking.

Travelers should also consider alternative departure times, nearby airports when practical, baggage allowances, and connecting routes.

Waytransit Travels & Tourism provides international air ticket booking services from Abu Dhabi and helps travelers compare available routes and airline options.

Visa Assistance for International Travel from UAE

Visa requirements are one of the most important things to check before booking an international trip.

The required visa can depend on your nationality, passport validity, UAE residence status, destination, purpose of travel, and length of stay.

If you are unsure about the application process, professional international visa assistance can help you understand documentation, application procedures, and destination-specific requirements.

Waytransit Travels & Tourism states that its international visa service covers destinations including Schengen countries, the UK, USA, Canada, Australia, and other international destinations.

Planning Your International Holiday from Abu Dhabi

The best international holiday does not necessarily mean traveling the furthest. A well planned short trip to Azerbaijan or Georgia may be more enjoyable than rushing through a distant destination.

Before booking, compare:

  • Flight schedules
  • Total airfare
  • Hotel prices
  • Visa requirements
  • Travel insurance
  • Airport transfers
  • Local transportation
  • Weather
  • Activities
  • Number of available vacation days

You can also compare complete international destinations from Abu Dhabi based on your preferred travel style rather than choosing solely by airfare.

For travelers who want to arrange flights, accommodation, tours, and visa support together, a travel agency can simplify the planning process.

Frequently Asked Questions

What are the best countries to visit from Abu Dhabi?

Some of the best countries to visit from Abu Dhabi include Oman, Azerbaijan, Georgia, Armenia, Saudi Arabia, Jordan, Egypt, Turkey, Kazakhstan, Maldives, Sri Lanka, Thailand, Malaysia, Seychelles, and Japan. The best choice depends on your budget, visa eligibility, travel season, and available time.

Which countries are closest to Abu Dhabi for a holiday?

Oman, Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, Qatar, and other nearby Gulf destinations are among the closest international options from Abu Dhabi. Oman is particularly suitable for travelers who want a short international break.

Where can I travel from Abu Dhabi for 3 to 5 days?

For a three to five day trip, consider Azerbaijan, Armenia, Georgia, Oman, Jordan, Saudi Arabia, or Egypt. These destinations can offer meaningful sightseeing experiences without requiring a very long vacation.

What are the cheapest international destinations from Abu Dhabi?

The most affordable destination varies according to airfare, hotel rates, season, exchange rates, and visa costs. Azerbaijan, Armenia, Georgia, Oman, and some Central Asian destinations can be worth comparing when searching for affordable international trips from Abu Dhabi.

Which countries are easy to visit from Abu Dhabi?

There is no single list that applies to every traveler because visa requirements depend heavily on nationality and residency status. Travelers should check the current entry rules for their passport before booking.

What are the best weekend getaways from Abu Dhabi?

Oman, Azerbaijan, Armenia, Georgia, Saudi Arabia, and Jordan can be considered for weekend getaways from Abu Dhabi. Your best option will depend on flight availability, entry requirements, and the amount of time you want to spend at your destination.

Which destinations offer holiday packages from Abu Dhabi?

Holiday packages from Abu Dhabi are available for destinations across Asia, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and other regions. Waytransit Travels & Tourism currently lists packages for destinations including Turkey, Egypt, Japan, Thailand, Armenia, Georgia, Kazakhstan, Switzerland, and other international locations.

What visa do I need when traveling from Abu Dhabi?

The required visa depends on your passport nationality, destination, UAE residency status, purpose of travel, and length of stay. UAE residents should check the destination’s latest official requirements before booking flights or accommodation.

How can I book flights from Abu Dhabi for an international holiday?

You can compare airline routes and travel dates online or use a travel agency for assistance. Waytransit Travels & Tourism provides international air ticket booking services and can help travelers compare available flight options.

How far in advance should I book an international holiday from Abu Dhabi?

There is no universal booking window because airfare and hotel prices vary by destination, season, airline, and demand. For popular travel periods, booking earlier generally gives you more choice of flights and accommodation.

Final Thoughts

Abu Dhabi’s location makes it an excellent base for international travel. From quick escapes to Oman and Azerbaijan to longer adventures in Japan and Thailand, there are destinations for almost every type of traveler.

If you want a short break, focus on nearby destinations that can be comfortably covered in three to five days. For families and couples, Turkey, Georgia, Egypt, Thailand, and Malaysia offer a broader mix of experiences. For beach holidays, Maldives, Seychelles, and Sri Lanka are strong choices, while Japan is ideal for travelers who have more time.

Before booking, compare airfare, accommodation, visa requirements, travel insurance, and the overall cost of your itinerary.
